title.narrative: Moving the HIV and TB responses towards 90-90-90 and sustainability with a focus on key and vulnerable populations - Honduras (01-Aug-2019-31-Jul-2022)

description.narrative: Honduras, TB/HIV, GLOBAL COMMUNITIES, INC. (GC Honduras)This program has the following goals: New HIV infections among men who have sex with men account for a maximum of 30% of all new infections.. 80% of persons living with HIV, who are on ART, remain on ART.. Detect at least 85 percent of TB patients by 2020, in line with WHO estimates.. Reduce TB mortality by 25 percent in 2020 compared to 2015.. The objectives of this program are: New HIV infections among men who have sex with men account for a maximum of 30% of all new infections.. 80% of persons living with HIV, who are on ART, remain on ART.. Improve implementation of quality DOTS strategy in the patient-centered TB comprehensive care and prevention framework.. Strengthen the laboratory network to improve diagnosis and the response to the new challenges proposed in the Stop TB strategy.. Strengthen the comprehensive approach to TB/HIV co-infection.. Improve clinical and programmatic management of MDR-TB.. Develop TB prevention and control activities for vulnerable populations.
